biotools.summary: Foldseek-Multimer is an open-source software and webserver for rapidly aligning protein complexes, achieving 3-4 orders of magnitude speedup compared to existing methods while maintaining comparable accuracy.  It is designed to handle the growing number of predicted protein complex structures.
